newsitem.title: USA: Pac Bell, Mitsubishi in deal.
newsitem.headline: Pac Bell, Mitsubishi in deal.

text.p: Pacific Telesis Group's Pacific Bell Mobile Services said it will buy $50 million in new wireless phones manufactured by Mitsubishi Wireless Communications Inc.
The new phones will operate on the Pac Bell's Personal Communications Services network, presently under construction in California and Nevada.

Under the two-year deal, Mitsubishi will start delivering the phones to Pac Bell by the second quarter of 1997. The phones will be sold as an off-the-shelf retail product co-branded by Pacific Bell Mobile Services and Mitsubishi.
Pacific Bell Mobile Services also said it will launch its new wireless telecommunications technology in San Diego on November 1.
Mitsubishi Wireless Communications Inc is a joint venture between consumer electronics giant Mitsubishi Electric Corp and trading company Mitsubishi Corp.
